summary: Defines the Encapsulating Security Payload, a header that can provide confidentiality, data origin authentication and replay protection for IPv4 and IPv6 packets. It is the part of IPsec that actually encrypts traffic. It was replaced by RFC 4303 and RFC 4305.

eli5.summary: ESP is like putting your letter in an opaque envelope and sealing it. Anyone along the way can see the envelope travel past but cannot read what is inside.

questions: what is the encapsulating security payload
